## Summary

Describe the user or engineering problem and the chosen solution.

## Scope

- [ ] Change is focused and does not revert unrelated work.
- [ ] Client-completion and production-scale claims are accurate.
- [ ] No secrets, personal books, tokens, or signed URLs are included.

## Verification

List the exact commands and manual checks run, with their results.

## Contract and Documentation

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] OpenAPI was updated if the API contract changed.
- [ ] Relevant human documentation was updated.
- [ ] UI changes include sanitized screenshots and keyboard/touch checks.
- [ ] Licensing and upstream notices remain intact.

## Risks

Describe migration, compatibility, security, data-loss, or rollback concerns.
